about: What the bot sends that the phone app reads (app/src/app/node/replies.ts), so changing a reply can't silently break the app.
tests/test_app_replies.py runs each case against the bot's real commands and checks the messages are exactly these; the app's tests (replies.spec.ts) check it reads each as `parsed`.
A case: `before`, steps run first ([sender, text]); then `as` sends `send`. `reply` is what comes back to `as`; or, with `to`, the direct messages the node sends `to` meanwhile (a notice).
A `split` case: the bot splits `text` into `reply`, and the app puts it back together.

cases.name: whoami, a user with a setting and a message waiting
before: msg Erin see you at the shelter
reply: Erin (e0e0e0e0e0e0); no passphrase; qm erin@example.com; 1 message(s), 1 unread
